_help: A-35 (2026-11-27, not play tested): named weapons in the spirit of Elden Ring (original names), colossal arms, greatshields and unexpected items used as weapons (scripts/WeaponFinds.cs). Each find: name (fixed, never re-rolled), slot (weapon by default, or shield), type (data/weapons.json type), model (data/weapons.json kitModels; shields pick theirs by name from data/avatar.json kitShields), elem ("" = none, missing = rolled by rarity), rar [lowest, highest] rarity (0 Common .. 4 Legendary), minLvl (never before this hero / area level), weight (among the finds a source may give), size (fixed size factor, 0 = rolled; data/weapons.json size), statMul (stats x this, like uniques), from (where it can come from), text (flavour shown on the item). Sources: kill:<enemy type> (data/enemies.json), boss (any boss), dungeon:<barrow|warrens|depths> (kills and chests on that dungeon's floors), chest (chests in the world and in dungeons), wayside (roadside site chests), shop (any trader's wares), pedlar (pedlars: the junk merchants, data/npcs.json role pedlar), fishing (sunken chests). chance: the odds that a source gives a find at all (kill = for an enemy type some find names; dungeonKill = any kill on a dungeon floor; shop = one named piece among a trader's wares; pedlar = how many curios a pedlar carries [min, max]).

finds.name: Grave Warden Greatsword
finds.text: Carried by the wardens who kept the barrow-dead in their graves. It was never meant to be lifted by the living.

finds.name: Ruinous Slab
finds.text: Not forged so much as poured. The heat of the deep forges still glows in its cracks.

finds.name: Dune Reaver
finds.text: A curved greatsword of the sand kings, made to cut riders out of the saddle.

finds.name: Giant-Hewn Axe
finds.text: The hill giants felled whole forests with these. A storm still sleeps in the bits.

finds.name: Starfall Maul
finds.text: Its head fell from the night sky. Three villages fought over it; none of them could lift it.

finds.name: Cathedral Estoc
finds.text: A knight's thrusting sword that hung for a century above a cathedral altar.

finds.name: Mist-Edge Uchigatana
finds.text: Its edge is said to part the morning mist without stirring it.

finds.name: Bishop's Flanged Mace
finds.text: Clergy may not shed blood, the bishop said, and broke the heretic's skull instead.

finds.name: Bellkeeper's Maul
finds.text: It rang the barrow bells to keep the dead asleep. They woke anyway.

finds.name: Hallowed Seal
finds.text: A sacred seal. Prayers spoken through it are answered a little sooner.

finds.name: Woodsman's Felling Axe
finds.text: Swung at oaks for forty years, then at wolves, then at worse.

finds.name: Bastion Greatshield
finds.text: Big enough to hide behind, heavy enough to regret it.

finds.name: Crusader's Greatshield
finds.text: The painted cross has worn away. The dents have not.

finds.name: Cellar Door
finds.text: Somebody took it off its hinges. Somebody was right to.

finds.name: Dinner Bell
finds.text: It once called a whole inn to supper. Now it calls goblins to the ground.

finds.name: Witch's Broom
finds.text: It will not fly, however nicely you ask. It sweeps very hard, though.

finds.name: Siege Ladder
finds.text: Nine rungs, two rails and a great deal of reach.

finds.name: Barbican Door
finds.text: Torn off a gatehouse. The bolt is still drawn.

finds.name: Drowned Anchor
finds.text: Hauled up from a wreck with half the sea still clinging to it.

finds.name: Lamplighter's Post
finds.text: The lamplighter took it with him when the town stopped paying him.

finds.name: Frozen Tuna
finds.text: Caught in the far north, frozen solid, and harder than most cudgels.

finds.name: Tavern Brawler's Chair
finds.text: Every tavern has one chair nobody sits in. This is why.

finds.name: Minstrel's Lute
finds.text: Out of tune, but it hits every note.

finds.name: Pitch Torch
finds.text: Pine pitch and old rags. It burns for hours, and so do the people it hits.

finds.name: Gravedigger's Spade
finds.text: He dug the barrow's graves for thirty years. Some of his customers came back.

finds.name: Angry Mob's Pitchfork
finds.text: There is always an angry mob. This is what is left of one.
